title: 第六章     信件
content_zh:
王艺没有多说话，见到苏林依已经下定决心要被这个卖假药的骗子骗了，压下心中的怒气，直接走了，他也知道现在多说多错，自己再多说几句，可能以后苏林依都不会理自己了。

    见到王艺终于走了，苏林依松了一口气，她可是真怕因为王艺，这个卖药丸的摊主不肯卖自己药了，虽然她也认为陈木是骗子，不过自己的母亲也没几天活了，万一是真的呢。

    想到这苏林依说道：“摊主，那人走了，四万块钱你收下吧，你的两瓶药丸我都要了。”陈木见到苏林依着急的表情不似作假，叹息了一口，还是准备卖给苏林依。

    陈木此刻也是知道苏林依是谁了，宁华大学的第一校花，同样也是宁华市第一美女，这些信息出现在了陈木脑海中，而且原来的陈木虽然有着没有见过面的未婚妻，但却一直暗恋着苏林依，想到这，陈木就当是帮助这具身体的原主人一个忙。

    陈木将四万块钱收下，对苏林依说道：“直接将药丸放到病人嘴边，病人便可直接吸收。”

    苏林依接过药丸，顿时感觉到了一股清新的香气，竟然让得自己整个人都舒畅了不少，对于陈木的信心更足了，道：“摊主，我家就在不远处，能跟我一起去吗？”

    苏林依满怀期待的看着陈木，不过陈木自然不会跟苏林依去她家，这简直就是自暴身份，陈木现在只想多练点灵药，提升自己的实力。

    “不用了，我还有事。”陈木淡淡的摇了摇头，说完陈木便开始收拾起他的摊铺。

    陈木对于今天能卖出两粒药丸已经出乎了他的意料，对于这行陈木已经有些不想再继续做下去了，虽然自己的炼丹技术超群，但奈何识货的人太少，所以陈木准备了另外他的一个赚钱计划。

    苏林依见陈木不想去，也没多想，便拿着两粒药丸离开了。

    陈木看着苏林依离开，手里拿着四万块钱，准备立刻去药材市场买一些药材来炼制一些简单的灵气丹药，虽然陈木现在已经尽量的放平了自己的心态，但是一想到自己只有练气一层的实力，陈木心里就有些着急，他总感觉自己在苍月大陆似乎有些东西遗忘在那边。

    当然陈木的想法是好的，他也知道修炼需要一步一步的积累，不过陈木想要寻求突破，肯定需要找到一个单独的修炼场所，一直在学校修炼，肯定是不行的，太容易暴露自己。
content_en:
Wang Yi didn't say much. Seeing that Su Linyi had made up his mind to be deceived by this liar selling fake medicine, he suppressed the anger in his heart and left directly. He also knew that it would be wrong to say more now. If he said a few more words, Su Linyi might not care about him in the future.

Seeing that Wang Yi finally left, Su Linyi breathed a sigh of relief. She was really afraid that because of Wang Yi, the pill seller would not sell her medicine. Although she also thought Chen Mu was a liar, her mother didn't live for a few days, so what if it was true.

Thinking of this, Su Linyi said: "Stall owner, that man is gone. You can accept the 40,000 yuan. I want both of your bottles of pills." Seeing that Su Linyi's anxious expression did not seem to be fake, Chen Mu sighed and prepared to sell it to Su Linyi.

At this moment, Chen Mu also knew who Su Linyi was. The number one school beauty of Ninghua University was also the number one beauty in Ninghua City. This information appeared in Chen Mu's mind. Moreover, although it turned out that Chen Mu had a fiancée whom he had never met, he had always been secretly in love with Su Linyi. Thinking of this, Chen Mu regarded it as a favor to the original owner of this body.

Chen Mu accepted the 40,000 yuan and said to Su Linyi: "Put the pill directly to the patient's mouth, and the patient can absorb it directly."

Su Linyi took the pills and immediately felt a fresh aroma, which actually made her feel a lot more comfortable. She became more confident in Chen Mu and said, "Stall owner, my home is not far away. Can you come with me?"

Su Linyi looked at Chen Mu expectantly, but naturally Chen Mu would not go to her house with Su Linyi. This would be a self-destruction of his identity. Now Chen Mu just wants to practice more elixirs and improve his strength.

"No, I still have something to do." Chen Mu shook his head lightly, and after saying that, Chen Mu began to clear up his stall.

Chen Mu was beyond his expectation that he could sell two pills today. Chen Mu no longer wanted to continue in this business. Although his alchemy skills were superb, there were too few people who knew the product, so Chen Mu prepared another plan to make money.

Seeing that Chen Mu didn't want to go, Su Linyi didn't think much, so she took two pills and left.

Chen Mu watched Su Linyi leave, holding 40,000 yuan in his hand, and was going to immediately go to the medicinal material market to buy some medicinal materials to refine some simple spiritual energy elixirs. Although Chen Mu had tried to calm down his mentality now, when he thought that he only had the strength of the first level of Qi training, Chen Mu felt a little anxious. He always felt that he seemed to have forgotten something there in Cang Yue Continent.

Of course, Chen Mu's idea is good. He also knows that cultivation requires step-by-step accumulation. However, if Chen Mu wants to seek a breakthrough, he must find a separate cultivation place. It is definitely not possible to practice in school all the time. It will expose himself too easily.
